title: How the weights were learnt
note: text = subtitles; say = spelled for the voice. Numbers from experiments/logs/tinygpt.json, build/data/s8_weights_data.json (the same run re-recorded on Modal CPU: the loss curve matches the log exactly), the corpus generator and the Qwen2.5 Technical Report.

blocks.text: Our tiny GPT learns from one pile of text: Northbridge's own documents. 122,069 characters, dated 3 August to 23 October.
blocks.say: Our tiny GPT learns from one pile of text: Northbridge's own documents. A hundred and twenty-two thousand characters, dated the third of August to the twenty-third of October.

blocks.text: Three kinds of text. Most is generated from Northbridge's seed data: notes, stores entries and orders, with stock figures drawn at random, on purpose. Then e-mails between the staff. Then every line of its purchase policies. All shuffled together.
blocks.say: Three kinds of text. Most is generated from Northbridge's seed data: notes, stores entries and orders, with stock figures drawn at random, on purpose. Then e-mails between the staff. Then every line of its purchase policies. All shuffled together.

blocks.text: Then, cut a random window of 128 characters. The target is the same window, shifted by one. So every character is a test: guess the next one. A batch takes 32 windows.
blocks.say: Then, cut a random window of a hundred and twenty-eight characters. The target is the same window, shifted by one. So every character is a test: guess the next one. A batch takes thirty-two windows.

blocks.text: One training step. At every position, the model gives a probability to each of its 81 characters. Here it has read 4,600 on, and must guess h. Untrained, it gives h 1.6 percent.
blocks.say: One training step. At every position, the model gives a probability to each of its eighty-one characters. Here it has read four thousand six hundred, on, and must guess h. Untrained, it gives h one point six percent.

blocks.text: The loss measures the miss: minus the log of the probability of the right character. Here, 4.11. Guessing evenly would score 4.39.
blocks.say: The loss measures the miss: minus the log of the probability of the right character. Here, four point one one. Guessing evenly would score four point three nine.

blocks.text: The gradient says which way to move each of the 830,464 weights, so the right characters get more probability. Every weight takes a small step that way, at a learning rate of at most 0.002.
blocks.say: The gradient says which way to move each of the eight hundred and thirty thousand weights, so the right characters get more probability. Every weight takes a small step that way, at a learning rate of at most zero point zero zero two.

blocks.text: Repeat that 1,500 times, with a fresh batch each time. The loss falls from 4.59 to 0.23. The h now gets more than 99.99 percent. Before training, the model wrote noise. After, it writes Northbridge.
blocks.say: Repeat that fifteen hundred times, with a fresh batch each time. The loss falls from four point five nine to zero point two three. The h now gets more than ninety-nine point nine nine percent. Before training, the model wrote noise. After, it writes Northbridge.

blocks.text: Ask it for BAT-500 in Manchester stores. Ten tries, ten perfect stock lines: 2,400 on hand. 2,800. 2,100. All invented. The real 5,400 was in its text three times. It learnt the pattern, not the number.
blocks.say: Ask it for BAT five hundred in Manchester stores. Ten tries, ten perfect stock lines: two thousand four hundred on hand. Two thousand eight hundred. Two thousand one hundred. All invented. The real five thousand four hundred was in its text three times. It learnt the pattern, not the number.

blocks.text: Qwen learnt the same way, at vast scale: the same game on up to 18 trillion tokens, then instruction tuning on over a million examples, then preference learning. Its weights froze at release, on 19 September 2024. Emma asked on 26 October 2026.
blocks.say: Qwen learnt the same way, at vast scale: the same game on up to eighteen trillion tokens, then instruction tuning on over a million examples, then preference learning. Its weights froze at release, on the nineteenth of September, twenty twenty-four. Emma asked on the twenty-sixth of October, twenty twenty-six.
